title: CDT procedure-code mappings for the 16 OralCompass internal procedure keys, aggregated from opened public documents
publisher: aggregated — each mapping names its document (NC Medicaid; OPM FEDVIP 2026 brochures for MetLife, Delta Dental, Aetna, GEHA, UnitedHealthcare; Wisconsin ForwardHealth; Oklahoma Health Care Authority)

scope.geography: United States (NC Medicaid; federal FEDVIP; WI and OK Medicaid for code identification only)

retrieval_method: WebFetch (PDF→text). FEDVIP page numbers = footer line printed immediately after the row ('2026 <plan> <n> Enroll at www.BENEFEDS.gov'), ±1 where passes disagreed. NC Medicaid and Wisconsin PDFs carried no page markers.

NCMED26.label: NC Medicaid Dental Reimbursement Rates — General Dentist, Oral Surgeon, Pediatric Dentist, Periodontist, & Orthodontist — 'Last Revison Date: Apr 1, 2026' (ADA-hosted copy, 'Source: North Carolina Medicaid')

NCMED25.label: NC Medicaid Dental Reimbursement Rates — 'Last Revison Date: Jan 1, 2025' (ADA-hosted copy)

NCMED22.label: NC Medicaid Dental Reimbursement Rates — 'Effective Date: February 10, 2022' (NC DHHS original PDF)

FEDVIP-METLIFE-2026.label: The MetLife Federal Dental Plan, 2026 FEDVIP brochure OPM02-FEDVIP-02AP-11 (OPM)

FEDVIP-DELTA-2026.label: Delta Dental's Federal Employees Dental Program, 2026 FEDVIP brochure OPM02-FEDVIP-02AP-05 (OPM)

FEDVIP-GEHA-2026.label: G.E.H.A Connection Dental Federal, 2026 FEDVIP brochure 02AP-08 (OPM)

FEDVIP-UHC-2026.label: UnitedHealthcare Dental Plan, 2026 FEDVIP brochure OPM02-FEDVIP-02AP-15 (OPM)

WI-FORWARDHEALTH-TARGETED.label: Wisconsin ForwardHealth (Wisconsin Medicaid) 'Targeted Dental Codes' PDF — columns 'Code Description Reimbursement Rate' (no title line, no date, no page numbers in extracted text)

OK-OHCA-OCCLUSAL-GUARD.label: Oklahoma Health Care Authority 'OHCA Guideline' — PA Guidelines - Occlusal Guard — 'Effective Date: 12/21/2021'

reuse_terms: CDT codes and nomenclature are ADA copyright (see ada-cdt-license-terms.json). Descriptors recorded here are quoted as printed in the named public documents for identification of the source passages; FEDVIP brochures print 'Current Dental Terminology (CDT), Copyright © American Dental Association. All rights reserved.'; NC Medicaid prints 'CDT 2022 (including procedure codes, descriptions, and other data) is copyrighted by the American Dental Association. © 2022 American Dental Association. All rights reserved. Applicable FARS/DFARS apply.'
access_limits: WebFetch truncates long PDFs: the MetLife 02AP-11 text ended inside Class C Major (around brochure page 37), Delta 02AP-05 around page 57, Aetna 02AP-01 around page 28, GEHA 02AP-08 around page 29, UHC 02AP-15 around page 49 ('[Content truncated due to length...]'). Codes reported ABSENT from a brochure may lie beyond the truncation point; absence is only asserted for the readable portion.

One MetLife pass hallucinated rows on pages 35/37/43 (e.g., 'D5211 Complete maxillary denture', 'D3310 Endodontic therapy, molar'); a verification pass found none of those codes in the readable text, so those claims were discarded and nothing from them is used.
OPM BrochureJson endpoint (BrochureJson?brochureNumber=02AP-11&year=2026) returned the same partial brochure text; no additional codes.
MassHealth DEN-114 bulletin returned '[binary data]' and could not be read.
NC DHHS ServiceNow fee-schedule portal blocked by robots.txt.
Page numbers in FEDVIP brochures carry ±1 uncertainty where passes disagreed (noted per mapping).
